title: Workout Keep At Least
prompt: A workout report should hide small workout reps. Write a function that returns a new array containing only values greater than or equal to the minimum.

explanation.beginner:
Example: workoutKeepAtLeast([5,10,12,0], 8) produces [10,12]. Evaluate the selection rule for every record and preserve the qualifying values in the required order.

Compare “handles empty input”: input [[],8] produces []. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
